sources.cite: Row-level security (RLS) with Power BI, Microsoft Learn (last updated 2026-05-13)
sources.note: Read through summarizing fetches 2026-11-16. Relevant text: 'RLS only restricts data access for users with Viewer permissions. It doesn't apply to workspace Admin, Member, or Contributor roles'; 'If you want RLS to apply to people in a workspace, you can only assign them the Viewer role'; 'Microsoft 365 groups aren't supported and can't be added to any RLS roles'; supported: distribution groups, mail-enabled groups and Microsoft Entra security groups; 'Users who aren't assigned to any RLS role typically see no data (empty results)' (stated in the B2B troubleshooting section); dynamic example [UserEmail] = USERPRINCIPALNAME(); in the service USERPRINCIPALNAME() returns the user's UPN.

brief.situation: You are the BI developer at Cascade Outdoor Supply (fictional). The Regional Sales report has a Region Manager role that filters the Region table to the signed-in manager. This morning Priya Raman, the North region manager, wrote that she can see every region's margins. At 12:00 the 40 region managers open the report for the quarterly review. It is 10:30.
handover: The role was added last quarter; nobody checked it with a manager's account.
Finance's monthly close report and two others use the same semantic model, margin columns included.
howItWorks: Pick a step from the action list: open or profile something, run a query, a check or a test, change the code or the model, or ship the result. A cell marked with a pencil can be changed by picking a value. Nothing you pick is typed or executed: every step shows an authored result.
Each step takes working minutes, and the clock moves by the minutes it takes. The deadline runs on the same clock.
The console shows what is open, its flags, charts, tables and code, and the result of each step. 'Read the console' reads it aloud, and every chart can be shown as a table.
Shipping is final for this case. Afterwards you record what you found and explain your reasoning.

scoring.modelReasoning: RLS restricts only people whose workspace role is Viewer; Admin, Member and Contributor have edit permission on the semantic model and bypass it. The managers' group was a Member and the role was empty, so the filter never ran. The fix is least privilege plus a mapping: Viewer for sg-region-managers, and that security group in the Region Manager role (Microsoft 365 groups can't be added). A Viewer in no role sees no data, so both changes are needed, and a manager should confirm the result before the review. Dropping columns from a shared model breaks other reports and leaves row access unchanged.
